newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Poongsan plans slitting plant in China.
newsitem.headline: Poongsan plans slitting plant in China.

text.p: South Korea's Poongsan Corp plans to build a slitting centre for copper and copper alloy sheet and strip in China, company spokesman Kim Hee-choong said on Tuesday.
Kim said the centre was expected to be completed by next July in Dongguan shi, Guangdong and to have an annual production capacity of 18,000 tonnes in 2000.
Poongsan would supply its cold rolled copper and copper sheet to the centre, he said.
He added it also plans to build a copper tube plant in China in 1998, which will annually produce 5,000 tonnes of inner grooved tube for air-conditioners and refrigerators.
Poongsan exported 14,000 tonnes of copper products to China this year.
